evidence.title: ROBOTOORIGIN - Fully Open-Source DIY Humanoid Robot

name: ROBOTOORIGIN
summary: Fully open-source DIY humanoid robot: hardware designs, ROS2 deployment and RL training code in one repo.
description: RoboParty's ROBOTOORIGIN is a running, jumping DIY humanoid robot released as a snapshot repo aggregating eight sub-repositories: mechanical CAD and PCB hardware, a ROS2 deployment framework, IsaacLab RL training with Sim2Sim transfer to MuJoCo, URDF/MJCF models, firmware, navigation and XR teleoperation. Includes a BOM and full R&D documentation.
contains: 8 sub-repositories: hardware, deploy, train, description, firmware, appearance, navigation, xr teleop
RL training in IsaacLab with Sim2Sim transfer to MuJoCo
ROS2 deployment framework with IMU and motor driver support
mechanical CAD drawings, PCB design and a BOM table
assemblable from Taobao parts and Jialichuang prototyping
aggregation layer under GNU GPL v3; module snapshots keep their own licenses
